name: Yamato
source:
Birth year: 1992

[spoiler]Main character of "Story 4 - Shimaigusa"

[url=/c92074]Sumire[/url]'s friend. He comes along with Sumire in order to help [url=/c88249]You[/url] overcome her fear of seeing "shadows".

Yamato also possesses the ability to sense "shadows", albeit weaker than Sumire. Has been hanging out with Sumire since when he is 6 years old, yet sometimes he couldn't comprehend her actions and emotions.[/spoiler]
